title: Life Plan Member Courtesy on Assisted Living Late Fees
content:
Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, a member of a Larkspur Life Plan receives a courtesy reduction on the late fee:

- a customer whose **Entrance Fee Agreement** is in occupied status with an **occupancy date at least 60 whole months** before the handling date has the late fee multiplied by **0.8**;
- a customer with an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement of **shorter standing** has it multiplied by **0.9**;
- a customer **without** an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement has no courtesy reduction.

The courtesy reduction acts on the whole late fee before it is rounded once to the cent. Whole months run from the occupancy date to the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the occupancy date.

| Entrance Fee Agreement (hypothetical) | Courtesy multiplier | Late fee of 111.36 becomes |
|---|---|---|
| Occupied, occupancy date 1 April 2021, handling date 1 April 2026 (60 whole months) | 0.8 | 89.09 |
| Occupied, occupancy date 2 April 2021, handling date 1 April 2026 (59 whole months) | 0.9 | 100.22 |
| Terminated, or none | None | 111.36 |
